commands.cmd: python3 -m leviath_workflow run --dag tests/fixtures/branch_join.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['ok'] is True and d['blocked'] is False; assert len(d['results'])==4; assert d['results']['join']['outputs']['combined']=='HELLO|olleh'; assert d['results']['left']['outputs']['result']=='HELLO'; assert d['results']['right']['outputs']['result']=='olleh'"

python3 -m leviath_workflow step --dag tests/fixtures/branch_join.json --step left --input in_val=hello | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['ok'] is True; assert d['mode']=='step' and d['step']=='left'; assert list(d['results'])==['left']; assert d['results']['left']['outputs']['result']=='HELLO'; assert d['dag_check']['ok'] is True"

python3 -m leviath_workflow run --dag tests/fixtures/cycle.json > /tmp/gql07_cycle.json; test $? -eq 1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/gql07_cycle.json')); assert d['blocked'] is True and d['results']=={}; assert any('cycle' in e.lower() for e in d['errors'])"

python3 -m leviath_workflow run --dag tests/fixtures/sensitive_unapproved.json > /tmp/gql07_sens.json; test $? -eq 1 && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/gql07_sens.json')); assert d['blocked'] is True and d['results']=={}; assert any('unapproved' in e.lower() for e in d['errors'])"

python3 -m leviath_workflow run --dag tests/fixtures/sensitive_unapproved.json --waive-step push_prod --waiver-identity release-manager --waiver-reason 'approved by CAB-42' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['ok'] is True and d['blocked'] is False; w=d['waivers'][0]; assert w['identity']=='release-manager' and w['reason']=='approved by CAB-42' and w['severity']=='WARN' and w['step']=='push_prod'"
python3 -m leviath_workflow run --dag tests/fixtures/sensitive_unapproved.json --waive-step push_prod --waiver-identity '' --waiver-reason '' >/dev/null; test $? -eq 1
for s in 0 1 7 12345 random; do PYTHONHASHSEED=$s python3 -m leviath_workflow run --dag tests/fixtures/cycle.json | sha256sum; done | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | wc -l | grep -qx 1
